scope_en: Actual OCR of ten new fictional PNG fixtures followed by the loaded site parser. No ground truth was provided to OCR or parser. No browser/mobile-camera test.
scope_zh: 十张新虚构PNG素材均真实读取并执行OCR，再调用加载的站点解析器；没有将标准答案提供给OCR或解析器；未测试浏览器/手机相机流程。

home_fixture_primary_field_metrics.method: Primary company, worker, service address, service date, issue date, full description, literal invoice total and currency. Null expected values counted separately; no overall accuracy percent. Restaurant content excluded from home-field score. Description requires normalized-whitespace exact match; all actual descriptions are null.

critical_findings_en: No company, actual worker, service date, work summary, total or currency was extracted from any of the ten images.
The UK locale was explicitly passed and retained in all ten records. No image reached a supported date/amount label, so this run does not demonstrate successful UK value extraction.
Case 05 produced an incomplete nonempty service address: first street line only, omitting locality and postcode.
Restaurant case 10 remained uncertain because raw OCR has Restaurant but no receipt/invoice keyword; explicit unrelated routing failed.
All worker fields stayed blank: no customer/preparer/server/proposed-worker substitution, but no actual worker recovered.
Nine home fixtures: 0 complete review outcomes. Quotation 04 stays planned and payment unknown.
OCR also loses brand headers and damages some amounts/postcodes: 08 has E75 00, 09 has £1 80 00. Those financial strings must not be silently repaired.
critical_findings_zh: 十张图片均没有提取公司、实际施工人、服务日期、工作摘要、总额或币种。
十条记录都实际传入并保留en-GB；图片中的日期/金额标签均未走到可识别分支，因此不能把本轮称为英国规则已识别成功。
05给出不完整的非空服务地址：只有街道行，遗漏地区与邮编。
10餐厅素材因OCR没有receipt/invoice字样而仍为uncertain，明确无关路由未通过。
worker全空，未出现客户/制单人/服务员/计划施工人冒充实际施工人，但也没识别出任何实际施工人。
九张家居素材没有完整review结果；04报价仍保持planned且付款unknown。
OCR本身还漏掉公司大字标题并损坏部分金额/邮编；08变成E75 00，09变成£1 80 00，不能静默修补财务字符串。
